answer_text: The default Cato license includes 3 unique public IPs for egress (usable from any PoP). If you need additional IPs or a fixed IP, use Network > IP Allocation to allocate a static public IP for egress. For VoIP egress rules referencing a specific public IP in ACLs, Cato recommends using a static public IP and configuring a Network Rule to NAT traffic to that IP (you can allocate it via IP Allocation).
